entries.reason: the squared Euclidean distance between two strided rows, as the header's own Maps line gives it: C[0] = sum((A[n] - B[n]) ** 2, 0 <= n < N) - one scalar out, a window of N, and no inner count because there is no inner dimension
entries.effect: one float at C[0], accumulated left to right in float over N elements read at the two given strides, with nothing else in C touched; N = 0 answers 0
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4, which declares it at 5.0 with the Maps line, and the 5.1.1 guest as the oracle
